import uuid
import re
from datetime import datetime, timezone


def init_db(conn) -> None:
    """Create the photos table if it does not exist."""
    conn.execute("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS photos (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            title TEXT NOT NULL,
            description TEXT,
            s3_key TEXT NOT NULL,
            uploaded_at TEXT NOT NULL
        )
    """)
    conn.commit()


def save_photo_metadata(conn, title, description, s3_key) -> int:
    """Insert a photo metadata row and return its id."""
    timestamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    cursor = conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO photos (title, description, s3_key, uploaded_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (title, description, s3_key, timestamp)
    )
    conn.commit()
    return cursor.lastrowid


def search_photos(conn, term) -> list[dict]:
    """Search photos by title or description, case-insensitively."""
    cursor = conn.execute(
        """
        SELECT id, title, description, s3_key, uploaded_at
        FROM photos
        WHERE LOWER(title) LIKE LOWER(?) OR LOWER(description) LIKE LOWER(?)
        ORDER BY id ASC
        """,
        (f"%{term}%", f"%{term}%")
    )
    columns = [desc[0] for desc in cursor.description]
    results = []
    for row in cursor.fetchall():
        results.append(dict(zip(columns, row)))
    return results


def upload_photo(s3, bucket, filename, data, content_type) -> str:
    """Validate and upload a photo, returning its S3 object key."""
    if content_type not in ("image/jpeg", "image/png"):
        raise ValueError(f"Invalid content type: {content_type}")
    
    if len(data) > 5 * 1024 * 1024:
        raise ValueError("File exceeds 5 MiB limit")
    
    # Extract base name and sanitize
    base_name = filename.split("/")[-1]
    safe_name = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9._-]", "_", base_name)
    
    # Generate key
    unique_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
    key = f"photos/{unique_id}/{safe_name}"
    
    # Upload
    s3.put_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key, Body=data, ContentType=content_type)
    
    return key


def photo_url(s3, bucket, key, expires=3600) -> str:
    """Generate a presigned GET URL for a photo."""
    if not (1 <= expires <= 3600):
        raise ValueError("expires must be between 1 and 3600 seconds inclusive")
    
    return s3.generate_presigned_url(
        "get_object",
        Params={"Bucket": bucket, "Key": key},
        ExpiresIn=expires
    )


def handle_upload(conn, s3, bucket, title, description, filename, data, content_type) -> int:
    """Upload a photo and save its metadata."""
    key = upload_photo(s3, bucket, filename, data, content_type)
    
    try:
        photo_id = save_photo_metadata(conn, title, description, key)
    except Exception:
        s3.delete_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key)
        raise
    
    return photo_id

InstanceType: Description: EC2 instance type for the web server. Type: String Default: t3.micro AllowedValues: - t3.micro LatestAmiId: Description: Latest Amazon Linux 2023 AMI, resolved at deploy time from the public SSM parameter. Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value Default: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64 Resources: WebServerSecurityGroup: Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup Properties: GroupDescription: Allow inbound HTTPS from anywhere and SSH from the administrator CIDR only SecurityGroupIngress: - Description: HTTPS from anywhere IpProtocol: tcp FromPort: 443 ToPort: 443 CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0 - Description: SSH from administrator CIDR IpProtocol: tcp FromPort: 22 ToPort: 22 CidrIp: !Ref AdminCidr Tags: - Key: Name Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-sg' WebServerInstance: Type: AWS::EC2::Instance Properties: ImageId: !Ref LatestAmiId InstanceType: !Ref InstanceType KeyName: !Ref KeyName SecurityGroupIds: - !GetAtt WebServerSecurityGroup.GroupId UserData: Fn::Base64: !Sub | #!/bin/bash set -euxo pipefail # Install Apache HTTP Server and mod_ssl dnf install -y httpd mod_ssl openssl # Ensure a self-signed TLS certificate exists for mod_ssl's default vhost if [ ! -f /etc/pki/tls/certs/localhost.crt ] || [ ! -f /etc/pki/tls/private/localhost.key ]; then openssl req -x509 -nodes -newkey rsa:2048 -days 365 \ -subj "/CN=$(hostname -f)" \ -keyout /etc/pki/tls/private/localhost.key \ -out /etc/pki/tls/certs/localhost.crt chmod 600 /etc/pki/tls/private/localhost.key fi # Write the index page cat > /var/www/html/index.html <<'EOF' Web server

Hello from Amazon Linux 2023

Apache httpd with mod_ssl, deployed by stack ${AWS::StackName} in ${AWS::Region}.

EOF # Start httpd now and enable it at boot systemctl enable --now httpd Tags: - Key: Name Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-server' Outputs: InstanceId: Description: ID of the web server instance. Value: !Ref WebServerInstance PublicDnsName: Description: Public DNS name of the web server instance. Value: !GetAtt WebServerInstance.PublicDnsName WebsiteURL: Description: HTTPS URL of the website (self-signed certificate). Value: !Sub 'https://${WebServerInstance.PublicDnsName}' SecurityGroupId: Description: ID of the web server security group. Value: !GetAtt WebServerSecurityGroup.GroupId ```

```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Photo-sharing website: custom VPC (10.0.0.0/16) with public web subnets and
  private database subnets across two Availability Zones, a web server built
  from a launch template on a custom AMI, and an encrypted RDS for MySQL instance
  reachable only from the web server.

Parameters:
  WebAmiId:
    Description: Custom AMI ID created in the labs (Apache and PHP web server image)
    Type: AWS::EC2::Image::Id

  KeyName:
    Description: Existing EC2 key pair for SSH access to the web server
    Type: AWS::EC2::KeyPair::KeyName

  AdminCidr:
    Description: CIDR block of the administrators' network allowed to use SSH (for example 203.0.113.10/32)
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(\d|[1-2]\d|3[0-2])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Networking
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-2'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.11.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.12.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-2'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # Private route table has no default route, so the private subnets have no internet route.
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt'

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Security groups
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  WebSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Web tier - HTTP and HTTPS from anywhere, SSH from administrators only
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: HTTP from anywhere
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: HTTPS from anywhere
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 22
          ToPort: 22
          CidrIp: !Ref AdminCidr
          Description: SSH from administrators network
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-sg'

  DatabaseSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Database tier - MySQL only from the web server security group
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 3306
          ToPort: 3306
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref WebSecurityGroup
          Description: MySQL from web server only
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db-sg'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Web tier
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  WebLaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-lt-${AWS::AccountId}'
      LaunchTemplateData:
        ImageId: !Ref WebAmiId
        InstanceType: t3.micro
        KeyName: !Ref KeyName
        SecurityGroupIds:
          - !Ref WebSecurityGroup
        UserData: !Base64 |
          #!/bin/bash -xe
          yum update -y
          yum install -y httpd php
          systemctl enable httpd
          systemctl start httpd
        TagSpecifications:
          - ResourceType: instance
            Tags:
              - Key: Name
                Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web'

  WebServer:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref WebLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt WebLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment

  WebServerElasticIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      InstanceId: !Ref WebServer
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-eip'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Database tier
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  DBSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Description: Master credentials for the photo-sharing RDS instance
      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: '{"username": "admin"}'
        GenerateStringKey: password
        PasswordLength: 24
        ExcludePunctuation: true

  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Private subnets for the photo-sharing database
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  DBInstance:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    DeletionPolicy: Snapshot
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Snapshot
    Properties:
      Engine: mysql
      DBInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
      AllocatedStorage: '20'
      StorageType: gp2
      StorageEncrypted: true
      MasterUsername: admin
      MasterUserPassword: !Sub '{{resolve:secretsmanager:${DBSecret}:SecretString:password}}'
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      VPCSecurityGroups:
        - !Ref DatabaseSecurityGroup
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      MultiAZ: false
      BackupRetentionPeriod: 7
      CopyTagsToSnapshot: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db'

Outputs:
  WebsiteURL:
    Description: URL of the photo-sharing website
    Value: !Sub 'http://${WebServerElasticIP}'

  DatabaseEndpoint:
    Description: Endpoint address of the RDS for MySQL database (private, reachable only from the web server)
    Value: !GetAtt DBInstance.Endpoint.Address

  DatabasePort:
    Description: Port of the RDS for MySQL database
    Value: !GetAtt DBInstance.Endpoint.Port
```

```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Photo-sharing site - custom VPC, public web tier (launch template + instance with Elastic IP), private encrypted RDS MySQL

Parameters:
  AmiId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Image::Id
    Description: Custom AMI created in the labs (must be available in this Region)
  AdminCidr:
    Type: String
    Description: Administrators' network allowed to SSH to the web server (CIDR, e.g. 203.0.113.0/24)
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR range
  KeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional existing EC2 key pair name for SSH access (leave empty for none)
  DBMasterUsername:
    Type: String
    Default: admin
    Description: Master username for the database
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]{0,15}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must begin with a letter; letters, digits and underscores only (max 16)

Conditions:
  HasKeyName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref KeyName, '']]

Resources:
  # ---------------- Network ----------------
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  GatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-2'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.3.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-2'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: GatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # Private route table: only the implicit local route, no internet route
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt'

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  # ---------------- Security groups ----------------

            #!/bin/bash
            if command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              dnf install -y httpd php php-mysqlnd || dnf install -y httpd php8.2 php8.2-mysqlnd
              SVC=httpd
            elif command -v yum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              yum install -y httpd php php-mysqlnd || yum install -y httpd php php-mysql
              SVC=httpd
            else
              export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
              apt-get update -y
              apt-get install -y apache2 php libapache2-mod-php php-mysql
              SVC=apache2
            fi
            systemctl enable $SVC
            systemctl start $SVC

  WebInstance:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref WebLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt WebLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber

  WebElasticIp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: GatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      InstanceId: !Ref WebInstance
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-eip'

  # ---------------- Database tier ----------------
  DatabaseSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Private subnets for the photo-sharing database
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  Database:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      Engine: mysql
      DBInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
      AllocatedStorage: '20'
      StorageType: gp2
      StorageEncrypted: true
      MultiAZ: false
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      MasterUsername: !Ref DBMasterUsername
      ManageMasterUserPassword: true
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DatabaseSubnetGroup
      VPCSecurityGroups:
        - !Ref DatabaseSecurityGroup
      BackupRetentionPeriod: 1

Outputs:
  WebsiteURL:
    Description: URL of the photo-sharing website
    Value: !Sub 'http://${WebElasticIp}'
  DatabaseEndpoint:
    Description: RDS MySQL endpoint address
    Value: !GetAtt Database.Endpoint.Address

    Description: RDS MySQL port
    Value: !GetAtt Database.Endpoint.Port

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Stage 2 - Custom VPC, database tier and launch template for photo-sharing website'

Parameters:
  CustomAMIId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Image::Id
    Description: Custom AMI ID for web server

    Properties:

        - Key: Name
          Value: PhotoSharingVPC

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicSubnet2

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.11.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.12.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateSubnet2

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PhotoSharingIGW

  AttachGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicRouteTable

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: AttachGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  WebSecurityGroup:

    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for web servers
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

        - IpProtocol: tcp

          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 22
          ToPort: 22
          CidrIp: !Ref AdminCIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebSecurityGroup

  DBSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for database
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 3306
          ToPort: 3306
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref WebSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: DBSecurityGroup

  WebLaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateData:
        ImageId: !Ref CustomAMIId
        InstanceType: t3.micro
        SecurityGroupIds:
          - !Ref WebSecurityGroup
        UserData:
          Fn::Base64: !Sub |
            #!/bin/bash
            yum update -y
            yum install -y httpd php
            systemctl start httpd
            systemctl enable httpd

  WebServerInstance:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref WebLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt WebLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebServer

  ElasticIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: AttachGateway
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      InstanceId: !Ref WebServerInstance

  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Subnet group for RDS database
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: DBSubnetGroup

  RDSInstance:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    Properties:
      Engine: mysql
      DBInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
      AllocatedStorage: 20
      MasterUsername: !Ref DBMasterUsername
      MasterUserPassword: !Ref DBMasterPassword
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      VPCSecurityGroups:
        - !Ref DBSecurityGroup
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      StorageEncrypted: true

Outputs:
  WebsiteURL:
    Description: Website URL
    Value: !Sub 'http://${ElasticIP}'
  
  DatabaseEndpoint:
    Description: Database endpoint address
    Value: !GetAtt RDSInstance.Endpoint.Address

    Properties:

      Tags:
        - Key: Name

    Properties:

        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443

        - IpProtocol: tcp

        - Key: Name

    Properties:

      DBInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
      AllocatedStorage: '20'

      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: photo-share-private-subnet-1

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.11.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: photo-share-private-subnet-2

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: photo-share-public-rt

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: photo-share-private-rt

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  ##########################
  # Security Groups
  ##########################

  WebSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow HTTP/HTTPS from anywhere and SSH from admin CIDR
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 22
          ToPort: 22
          CidrIp: !Ref AdminCidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: photo-share-web-sg

  DBSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow MySQL only from the web security group
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 3306
          ToPort: 3306
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt WebSecurityGroup.GroupId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: photo-share-db-sg

  ##########################
  # Web Server
  ##########################

  WebServerLaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-lt'
      LaunchTemplateData:
        ImageId: !Ref AmiId
        InstanceType: t3.micro
        SecurityGroupIds:
          - !GetAtt WebSecurityGroup.GroupId
        UserData:
          Fn::Base64: !Sub |
            #!/bin/bash -xe
            yum update -y
            yum install -y httpd php php-mysqlnd
            systemctl enable httpd
            systemctl start httpd
        TagSpecifications:
          - ResourceType: instance
            Tags:
              - Key: Name
                Value: photo-share-web-server

  WebServerInstance:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref WebServerLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt WebServerLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: photo-share-web-server

  WebServerEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      InstanceId: !Ref WebServerInstance
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: photo-share-web-eip

  ##########################
  # Database Tier
  ##########################

  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Private subnets for RDS MySQL
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: photo-share-db-subnet-group

  DBInstance:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    Properties:
      Engine: mysql
      DBInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
      AllocatedStorage: '20'
      StorageEncrypted: true
      MasterUsername: !Ref DBMasterUsername
      ManageMasterUserPassword: true
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      VPCSecurityGroups:
        - !GetAtt DBSecurityGroup.GroupId
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      MultiAZ: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: photo-share-db

Outputs:
  WebsiteURL:
    Description: URL of the photo-sharing website
    Value: !Sub 'http://${WebServerEIP}'

  DatabaseEndpoint:
    Description: RDS MySQL endpoint address
    Value: !GetAtt DBInstance.Endpoint.Address

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Secure, scalable, highly available photo-sharing website deployment'

Parameters:

            - HEAD
            - OPTIONS
            - PUT
            - POST
            - PATCH
            - DELETE
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD

          ForwardedValues:
            QueryString: true
            Headers:
              - '*'
            Cookies:
              Forward: all
          MinTTL: 0
          DefaultTTL: 0
          MaxTTL: 0

```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Secure, scalable, highly available photo-sharing website (VPC, ALB, ASG, RDS Multi-AZ, S3, CloudFront)

Resources:

    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16

          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  GatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  PublicSubnet1:

    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']

        - Key: Name

    Properties:

        - Key: Name

    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:

        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.0.11.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-2'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

    DependsOn: GatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

    Properties:

    Properties:

    Properties:

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  # -------------------------------------------------------- Security groups
  LoadBalancerSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow HTTP from the internet to the load balancer
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: HTTP from anywhere
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-alb-sg'

  WebServerSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow HTTP to web servers only from the load balancer
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref LoadBalancerSecurityGroup
          Description: HTTP from the load balancer only
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-sg'

  DatabaseSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow MySQL only from the web servers
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 3306
          ToPort: 3306
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref WebServerSecurityGroup
          Description: MySQL from web servers only
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db-sg'

  PhotoBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  PhotoBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref PhotoBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt PhotoBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${PhotoBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------- IAM
  WebServerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PhotoBucketAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ObjectAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:PutObject'
                  - 's3:GetObject'
                  - 's3:DeleteObject'
                Resource: !Sub '${PhotoBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Sid: ListBucket
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:ListBucket'
                Resource: !GetAtt PhotoBucket.Arn
        # Narrow read of the generated database credential, so the application can connect without a password in the template
        - PolicyName: ReadDatabaseSecret
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'secretsmanager:GetSecretValue'
                Resource: !GetAtt Database.MasterUserSecret.SecretArn

  WebServerInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref WebServerRole

  # --------------------------------------------------------------- Database
  DatabaseSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Private subnets for the photo-sharing database
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  Database:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    DeletionPolicy: Snapshot
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Snapshot
    Properties:
      Engine: mysql
      DBInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
      AllocatedStorage: '20'
      StorageType: gp3
      StorageEncrypted: true
      MultiAZ: true
      DBName: !Ref DBName
      MasterUsername: !Ref DBMasterUsername
      ManageMasterUserPassword: true
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DatabaseSubnetGroup
      VPCSecurityGroups:
        - !Ref DatabaseSecurityGroup
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      BackupRetentionPeriod: 7
      CopyTagsToSnapshot: true
      AutoMinorVersionUpgrade: true

  # --------------------------------------------------------- Load balancer
  LoadBalancer:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    DependsOn: PublicRoute
    Properties:
      Type: application
      Scheme: internet-facing
      IpAddressType: ipv4
      SecurityGroups:
        - !Ref LoadBalancerSecurityGroup
      Subnets:
        - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2
      LoadBalancerAttributes:
        - Key: routing.http.drop_invalid_header_fields.enabled
          Value: 'true'

  TargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Protocol: HTTP
      Port: 80
      TargetType: instance
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckPath: /
      HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: 30
      HealthCheckTimeoutSeconds: 5
      HealthyThresholdCount: 2
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3
      Matcher:
        HttpCode: '200-399'
      TargetGroupAttributes:
        - Key: deregistration_delay.timeout_seconds
          Value: '30'

  Listener:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref LoadBalancer
      Protocol: HTTP
      Port: 80
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroup

  # ----------------------------------------------------------- Auto Scaling
  LaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateData:
        ImageId: !Ref AmiId
        InstanceType: t3.micro
        IamInstanceProfile:
          Arn: !GetAtt WebServerInstanceProfile.Arn
        NetworkInterfaces:
          - DeviceIndex: 0
            AssociatePublicIpAddress: false
            Groups:
              - !Ref WebServerSecurityGroup
        MetadataOptions:
          HttpTokens: required
          HttpEndpoint: enabled
        UserData:
          Fn::Base64: !Sub |
            #!/bin/bash
            # Application settings (no passwords here; the DB credential is read from Secrets Manager at runtime)
            cat > /etc/photo-app.env <<EOF
            PHOTO_BUCKET=${PhotoBucket}
            AWS_REGION=${AWS::Region}
            DB_HOST=${Database.Endpoint.Address}
            DB_PORT=${Database.Endpoint.Port}
            DB_NAME=${DBName}
            DB_SECRET_ARN=${Database.MasterUserSecret.SecretArn}
            EOF
            chmod 640 /etc/photo-app.env
        TagSpecifications:
          - ResourceType: instance
            Tags:
              - Key: Name
                Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web'

  AutoScalingGroup:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::AutoScalingGroup
    DependsOn:
      - PrivateRoute1
      - PrivateRoute2
      - Listener
    Properties:
      MinSize: '2'
      MaxSize: '4'
      DesiredCapacity: '2'
      VPCZoneIdentifier:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref LaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt LaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      TargetGroupARNs:
        - !Ref TargetGroup
      HealthCheckType: ELB
      HealthCheckGracePeriod: 300
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web'
          PropagateAtLaunch: true
    UpdatePolicy:
      AutoScalingRollingUpdate:
        MinInstancesInService: 1
        MaxBatchSize: 1
        PauseTime: PT5M

  CpuScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      AutoScalingGroupName: !Ref AutoScalingGroup
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      TargetTrackingConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: ASGAverageCPUUtilization
        TargetValue: 60

  # ------------------------------------------------------------- CloudFront
  CloudFrontDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Enabled: true
        Comment: !Sub '${AWS::StackName} photo-sharing site'
        HttpVersion: http2
        IPV6Enabled: true
        PriceClass: PriceClass_100
        Origins:
          - Id: alb-origin
            DomainName: !GetAtt LoadBalancer.DNSName
            CustomOriginConfig:
              OriginProtocolPolicy: http-only
              HTTPPort: 80
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: alb-origin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
            - OPTIONS
            - PUT
            - POST
            - PATCH
            - DELETE
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          Compress: true
          # Managed policies: CachingDisabled and AllViewer (dynamic, session-based site)
          CachePolicyId: 4135ea2d-6df8-44a3-9df3-4b5a84be39ad
          OriginRequestPolicyId: 216adef6-5c7f-47e4-b989-5492eafa07d3
        ViewerCertificate:
          CloudFrontDefaultCertificate: true

Outputs:
  CloudFrontDomainName:
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name
    Value: !GetAtt CloudFrontDistribution.DomainName
  LoadBalancerDNSName:
    Description: DNS name of the Application Load Balancer
    Value: !GetAtt LoadBalancer.DNSName

  WebAutoScalingGroup:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::AutoScalingGroup
    Properties:
      AutoScalingGroupName: !Sub 'asg-${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      VPCZoneIdentifier:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      LaunchTemplate:

      MaxSize: 4

    Properties:
      AutoScalingGroupName: !Ref WebAutoScalingGroup
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      TargetTrackingConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:

    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:

        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1

    Properties:

    Properties:

      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref LoadBalancerSecurityGroup

  DatabaseSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for RDS database
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 3306
          ToPort: 3306
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref WebInstanceSecurityGroup

  # Load Balancer
  ApplicationLoadBalancer:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    Properties:
      Type: application
      Subnets:
        - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2
      SecurityGroups:
        - !Ref LoadBalancerSecurityGroup
      Scheme: internet-facing

  TargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Port: 80
      Protocol: HTTP
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      HealthCheckEnabled: true
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckPath: /health
      HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: 30
      HealthCheckTimeoutSeconds: 5
      HealthyThresholdCount: 2
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3
      TargetType: instance

  LoadBalancerListener:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref ApplicationLoadBalancer
      Port: 80
      Protocol: HTTP
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroup

  # IAM Role for EC2
  EC2Role:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3PhotoBucketAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource: !Sub '${PhotoBucket.Arn}/*'

  EC2InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref EC2Role

  # S3 Bucket for Photos
  PhotoBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'photo-bucket-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}'
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  # Launch Template
  WebLaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateData:
        ImageId: !Ref CustomAMIId
        InstanceType: t3.micro
        SecurityGroupIds:
          - !Ref WebInstanceSecurityGroup
        IamInstanceProfile:
          Arn: !GetAtt EC2InstanceProfile.Arn
        NetworkInterfaces:
          - DeviceIndex: 0
            AssociatePublicIpAddress: false

  # Auto Scaling Group
  WebAutoScalingGroup:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::AutoScalingGroup
    Properties:
      VPCZoneIdentifier:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref WebLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt WebLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      MinSize: 2
      MaxSize: 4
      DesiredCapacity: 2
      HealthCheckType: ELB
      HealthCheckGracePeriod: 300
      TargetGroupARNs:
        - !Ref TargetGroup

  # CloudWatch Alarm for CPU
  CPUAlarmHigh:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when CPU exceeds 70 percent
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Namespace: AWS/EC2
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      Threshold: 70
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: AutoScalingGroupName
          Value: !Ref WebAutoScalingGroup
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleUpPolicy

  # Scaling Policy
  ScaleUpPolicy:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
      AutoScalingGroupName: !Ref WebAutoScalingGroup
      ScalingAdjustment: 1

  # DB Subnet Group
  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Subnet group for RDS
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  # RDS Database
  RDSDatabase:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      Engine: mysql
      DBInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
      AllocatedStorage: 20
      StorageType: gp2
      StorageEncrypted: true
      MasterUsername: !Ref DBMasterUsername
      MasterUserPassword: !Ref DBMasterPassword
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      VPCSecurityGroups:
        - !Ref DatabaseSecurityGroup
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      MultiAZ: true
      EnableCloudwatchLogsExports:
        - error
        - general

  # CloudFront Distribution
  CloudFrontDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Enabled: true
        HttpVersion: http2
        Origins:
          - Id: LoadBalancerOrigin
            DomainName: !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancer.DNSName
            CustomOriginConfig:
              HTTPPort: 80
              OriginProtocolPolicy: http-only
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
            - OPTIONS
            - PUT
            - POST
            - PATCH
            - DELETE
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          Compress: true
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          TargetOriginId: LoadBalancerOrigin
          ForwardedValues:
            QueryString: true
            Headers:
              - '*'
            Cookies:
              Forward: all

Outputs:
  CloudFrontDomainName:
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name
    Value: !GetAtt CloudFrontDistribution.DomainName

  LoadBalancerDNSName:
    Description: Application Load Balancer DNS name
    Value: !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancer.DNSName

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-

  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16

      Tags:

    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-igw"

    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs !Ref AWS::Region]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-1"

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs !Ref AWS::Region]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-2"

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.10.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs !Ref AWS::Region]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-1"

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.11.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs !Ref AWS::Region]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-2"

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-rt"

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEipAddress.AllocationId

      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nat"

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:

    Properties:

    Properties:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Security groups
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LoadBalancerSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup

      GroupDescription: Allow inbound HTTP from the internet to the load balancer

      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp

          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: HTTP from anywhere
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-alb-sg"

  WebSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow HTTP only from the load balancer security group
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref LoadBalancerSecurityGroup
          Description: HTTP from the load balancer only
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-web-sg"

  DatabaseSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow MySQL only from the web instances
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 3306
          ToPort: 3306
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref WebSecurityGroup
          Description: MySQL from web tier only
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-db-sg"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Application Load Balancer
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ApplicationLoadBalancer:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    Properties:
      Scheme: internet-facing
      Type: application
      IpAddressType: ipv4
      Subnets:
        - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2
      SecurityGroups:
        - !Ref LoadBalancerSecurityGroup

        - Key: Name

      HealthCheckPath: /health

      HealthCheckTimeoutSeconds: 5
      HealthyThresholdCount: 3
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3
      Matcher:
        HttpCode: "200"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-web-tg"

  HttpListener:

        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true

      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:

      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

        - Key: Name

        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PhotoBucketObjectAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:

                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject

      Tags:

    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile

  # Launch template and Auto Scaling group

              - Key: Name
                Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-web-volume"

    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::AutoScalingGroup
    DependsOn: PrivateDefaultRoute
    Properties:
      VPCZoneIdentifier:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref WebLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt WebLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      MinSize: "2"
      MaxSize: "4"
      DesiredCapacity: "2"
      TargetGroupARNs:
        - !Ref WebTargetGroup
      HealthCheckType: ELB
      HealthCheckGracePeriod: 300
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-web-asg"
          PropagateAtLaunch: true

  WebCpuTargetTrackingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      AutoScalingGroupName: !Ref WebAutoScalingGroup
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      TargetTrackingConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: ASGAverageCPUUtilization
        TargetValue: 70
        DisableScaleIn: false

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # RDS MySQL (Multi-AZ, private, encrypted, managed master password)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Private subnets for the photo-sharing database
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-db-subnets"

  DBInstance:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    DeletionPolicy: Snapshot
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Snapshot
    Properties:
      Engine: mysql
      DBInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
      AllocatedStorage: "20"
      StorageType: gp3
      StorageEncrypted: true
      MultiAZ: true
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      VPCSecurityGroups:
        - !Ref DatabaseSecurityGroup
      MasterUsername: !Ref DBUsername
      ManageMasterUserPassword: true
      BackupRetentionPeriod: 7
      DeletionProtection: false
      CopyTagsToSnapshot: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-db"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudFront distribution in front of the load balancer
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CloudFrontDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Enabled: true
        Comment: !Sub "${AWS::StackName} photo-sharing distribution"
        HttpVersion: http2
        IPV6Enabled: true
        PriceClass: PriceClass_All
        Origins:
          - Id: AlbOrigin
            DomainName: !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancer.DNSName
            CustomOriginConfig:
              HTTPPort: 80
              HTTPSPort: 443
              OriginProtocolPolicy: http-only
              OriginSSLProtocols:
                - TLSv1.2
              OriginReadTimeout: 30
              OriginKeepaliveTimeout: 5
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: AlbOrigin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
            - OPTIONS
            - PUT
            - POST
            - PATCH
            - DELETE
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          Compress: true
          # Managed "CachingDisabled" policy (dynamic site content)
          CachePolicyId: 4135ea2d-6df8-44a3-9df3-4b5a84be39ad
          # Managed "AllViewer" origin request policy
          OriginRequestPolicyId: 216adef6-5c7f-47e4-b989-5492eafa07d3
        ViewerCertificate:
          CloudFrontDefaultCertificate: true

Outputs:
  CloudFrontDomainName:
    Description: Domain name of the CloudFront distribution (HTTPS entry point)
    Value: !GetAtt CloudFrontDistribution.DomainName

  LoadBalancerDNSName:
    Description: DNS name of the internet-facing Application Load Balancer
    Value: !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancer.DNSName

      HealthyThresholdCount: 3
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3
      Matcher:
        HttpCode: "200"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-web-tg"

  HttpListener:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener

  # Web tier: IAM, launch template, Auto Scaling
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WebInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PhotoBucketObjectAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow

                  - s3:GetObject

        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

        Version: !GetAtt WebLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber

    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy

        Statement:

            Effect: Deny

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

        - !Ref PublicSubnet2

    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:

          Arn: !GetAtt EC2InstanceProfile.Arn

          - !Ref WebInstanceSecurityGroup
        NetworkInterfaces:
          - DeviceIndex: 0

            Groups:
              - !Ref WebInstanceSecurityGroup

  WebAutoScalingGroup:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::AutoScalingGroup
    Properties:
      MinSize: 2
      MaxSize: 4
      DesiredCapacity: 2

        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref WebLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt WebLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      VPCZoneIdentifier:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      TargetGroupARNs:
        - !Ref TargetGroup
      HealthCheckType: ELB
      HealthCheckGracePeriod: 300
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-WebInstance'
          PropagateAtLaunch: true

  # Auto Scaling Policy
  CPUScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      AutoScalingGroupName: !Ref WebAutoScalingGroup
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      TargetTrackingConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: ASGAverageCPUUtilization
        TargetValue: 70.0

  # S3 Bucket
  PhotoBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PhotoBucket'

  # RDS Database
  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Subnet group for RDS database
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DBSubnetGroup'

  RDSDatabase:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    Properties:
      Engine: mysql
      DBInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
      AllocatedStorage: 20
      StorageType: gp2
      StorageEncrypted: true
      MultiAZ: true
      MasterUsername: !Ref DBMasterUsername
      MasterUserPassword: !Ref DBMasterPassword
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      VPCSecurityGroups:
        - !Ref DatabaseSecurityGroup
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-RDS'

  # CloudFront Distribution
  CloudFrontDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Enabled: true
        Origins:
          - DomainName: !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancer.DNSName
            Id: ALBOrigin
            CustomOriginConfig:
              HTTPPort: 80
              OriginProtocolPolicy: http-only
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: ALBOrigin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
            - OPTIONS
            - PUT
            - POST
            - PATCH
            - DELETE
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          ForwardedValues:
            QueryString: true
            Cookies:
              Forward: all
            Headers:
              - '*'
          MinTTL: 0
          DefaultTTL: 0
          MaxTTL: 0

Outputs:

    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name
    Value: !GetAtt CloudFrontDistribution.DomainName

    Value: !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancer.DNSName

        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      TargetGroupARNs:

    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:

      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling

        - Key: Name

      StorageType: gp2

      MasterUserPassword: !Ref DBMasterPassword

      Tags:
        - Key: Name

        DefaultCacheBehavior:

            QueryString: true
            Cookies:
              Forward: all
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
            - OPTIONS
            - PUT
            - POST
            - PATCH
            - DELETE
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
        Comment: !Sub CloudFront distribution for ${AWS::StackName}

Outputs:

    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name
    Value: !GetAtt CloudFrontDistribution.DomainName

    Description: Application Load Balancer DNS name
    Value: !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancer.DNSName

    Properties:

      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # NAT Gateway

    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: AttachGateway
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NATGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NATGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  # Private Route Table
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  PrivateRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NATGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # Security Groups
  LoadBalancerSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for load balancer
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0

  WebSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:

          ToPort: 80

  DatabaseSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for RDS database
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 3306
          ToPort: 3306
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref WebSecurityGroup

  # Load Balancer
  ApplicationLoadBalancer:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'alb-${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      Type: application
      Scheme: internet-facing
      SecurityGroups:
        - !Ref LoadBalancerSecurityGroup
      Subnets:
        - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2

  TargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'tg-${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      Port: 80
      Protocol: HTTP
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      HealthCheckEnabled: true
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckPath: /health
      HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: 30
      HealthCheckTimeoutSeconds: 5
      HealthyThresholdCount: 2
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3

  LoadBalancerListener:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref ApplicationLoadBalancer
      Port: 80
      Protocol: HTTP
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroup

  # S3 Bucket
  PhotoBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'photos-${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256

  # IAM Role for EC2
  EC2Role:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3PhotoBucketAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource: !Sub '${PhotoBucket.Arn}/*'

  EC2InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref EC2Role

  # Launch Template
  WebLaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateName: !Sub 'web-lt-${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      LaunchTemplateData:
        ImageId: !Ref CustomAMIId
        InstanceType: t3.micro
        IamInstanceProfile:
          Arn: !GetAtt EC2InstanceProfile.Arn
        SecurityGroupIds:
          - !Ref WebSecurityGroup
        AssociatePublicIpAddress: false

  # Auto Scaling Group
  WebAutoScalingGroup:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::AutoScalingGroup
    Properties:
      AutoScalingGroupName: !Sub 'asg-${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      VPCZoneIdentifier:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref WebLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt WebLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      MinSize: 2
      MaxSize: 4
      DesiredCapacity: 2
      HealthCheckType: ELB
      HealthCheckGracePeriod: 300
      TargetGroupARNs:
        - !Ref TargetGroup

  # Scaling Policy
  CPUScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      AutoScalingGroupName: !Ref WebAutoScalingGroup
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      TargetTrackingConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: ASGAverageCPUUtilization
        TargetValue: 70.0

  # RDS DB Subnet Group
  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Sub 'db-subnet-${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Subnet group for RDS database
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  # RDS Database
  MySQLDatabase:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      DBInstanceIdentifier: !Sub 'db-${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      Engine: mysql
      EngineVersion: '8.0'
      DBInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
      AllocatedStorage: 20
      StorageType: gp2
      StorageEncrypted: true
      MasterUsername: !Ref DBMasterUsername
      ManageMasterUserPassword: true
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      VPCSecurityGroups:
        - !Ref DatabaseSecurityGroup
      MultiAZ: true
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      EnableCloudwatchLogsExports:
        - error
        - general

  # CloudFront Distribution
  CloudFrontDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Enabled: true
        HttpVersion: http2
        Origins:
          - Id: LoadBalancerOrigin
            DomainName: !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancer.DNSName
            CustomOriginConfig:
              HTTPPort: 80
              OriginProtocolPolicy: http-only
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: LoadBalancerOrigin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
            - OPTIONS
            - PUT
            - POST
            - PATCH
            - DELETE
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          ForwardedValues:
            QueryString: true
            Cookies:
              Forward: all
            Headers:
              - '*'

Outputs:
  CloudFrontDomainName:
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name
    Value: !GetAtt CloudFrontDistribution.DomainName

  LoadBalancerDNSName:
    Description: DNS name of the Application Load Balancer
    Value: !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancer.DNSName
